Commentary.Commentary: That was pretty quick, 25 minutes to be precise! The England innings has come to an end for 336. The visitors won't be too happy but won't be too worried either. There is a lot of help for the spinners and they would like to quickly come back on to the field and bowl at the Lankans. The mainstay of the innings was Jonny Bairstow with his century yesterday, supported by Joe Root and Ben Stokes. This morning, the visitors could add only 24 runs to their overnight total. And this was the first time in the series that the England tailenders did not have at least one 50-run stand. Lakshan Sandakan achieved his best figures in Test cricket of 5-95. The Islanders will be happy and will look to come out and bat long. The first ball of the Lankan innings isn't far away, do join us in a bit for that!

OUT! What a catch! Angelo Mathews has taken a stunner. Tossed up ball around off, Jack Leach comes down the pitch and looks to go big. Gets more height towards long off. Mathews there runs back, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a stunner before tumbling over. ENGLAND ALL OUT FOR 336.
FOUR BYES! This one is on leg and the ball beats the keeper, who is blinded and rolls down to the fence.
Looped up again, Leach comes down the wicket and defends it.
Flatter ball on off, the leftie covers the spin and defends it.
Looped beautifully on off, turns off a crack and beats the outside edge of Leach.
Full and outside off, Rashid comes ahead and defends it to point.
Looped on middle, another inside edge, this time in the air, but there's no leg slip and the ball rolls to fine leg for a single.
Flatter delivery on off, Rashid pushes it to cover for a single.
Lots of flight again, it's the wrong 'un! Leach is ahead to defend but gets the inside edge that rolls on to the leg side for a single.
Jack Leach is the last man in.

OUT! Ali walks right into the trap set for him. Four dot balls in the over and he goes for a big one and just chips it straight to the fielder set for this exact shot. The ball is looped up generously by Perera and Ali dances down the wicket to hit it over the fence. Perhaps wanted to go over long on but in the end, just chips it straight to long off where Matthews makes no mistake. The Sri Lankans are very happy to have got the main man this early who had just started to time the ball well.
Flatter ball that drifts in on off, Ali punches it to short cover.
Looped up on middle, Ali jogs down and defends it to the bowler.
Flatter delivery that keeps low and drifts onto the pads, Ali does well to keep it out and push it to short leg.
Full and at the pads, Rashid tucks it behind towards fine leg and gets a run.
FOUR! Uppishly driven through the covers. But timing and placement is perfect from Mo. Expensive over, ten off it in the end.
Good length outside off, Rashid drops it on the offside and gets to the other end.
Fuller and outside off, Rashid defends it back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, Ali jabs it away behind square on the off side for a single to deep backward point.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Ali leans into this one and drives it beautifully through the covers for four runs.
Around the wicket, outside off on a length. Ali leaves it alone.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Rashid goes for the sweep and hits the full ball on his pads into the ground. The ball bounces above leg slip and runs away for four runs.
Flighted on middle, Rashid defends but the ball hits the inner half of the bat.

Flatter ball to Rashid. He defends it off the back foot.
First ball of the day is flighted on middle, Ali comes down the track and plays it to long on for a single.
The players are coming out to the middle. Moeen Ali to face the ball the first ball of the morning. Dilruwan Perera will continue his unfinished over.

Jonny Bairstow is being interviewed. He says that he is very pleased with the way he played after not playing for the last 4 weeks and not performing so well in the ODIs. Hopes that the spinners will do the job for them now. On his celebration, he says that it's the passion of playing for his country and doing well. About the conditions in Colombo, he says that it happens in professional cricket and they have to adjust to it and it's the same for both teams. Traveling to West Indies and then coming back here after a years time will be a good ask. Also adds that batting and scoring a hundred at no. 3 feels better than batting lower down the order. Ends by saying that the team will always take it if they win the toss, bat first and manage to score 300 on Day 1.

Hello and welcome to the Second Days play of the last and final Test between Sri Lanka and England in Colombo. The Brits have already won the series and are slightly ahead in the game after the end of Day 1, batting pretty well on a difficult pitch. Jonny Bairstow, making a comeback post injury and in an unfamiliar position no. 3, scored a century and along with the support of his skipper, Joe Root and Ben Stokes have put the visitors in a strong position. The hosts, though, managed to pick up seven wickets in the day and would like to knock out the ever wagging English tail for as less as possible. Chinaman Lakshan Sandakan was the stand-out performer with the ball and grabbed four wickets. As Day 2 begins, much will revolve around Moeen Ali, and how the tail bats around him. Day 1 saw the ball grip and turn, so today should be no different and the visitors' spinners will be licking their lips and looking forward to have a go at the Lankans. Hopefully, rain stays away and we have an uninterrupted game today. Join us for live action in a while!
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

So that is how it stands then. England still have 3 wickets left and all can bat. They will hope that the pair of Moeen and Rashid can get another 30-40 and then Leach and Broad tee off. 350 will be a minimum expectation but 400 could also be a possibility. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will hope to dismiss the visitors under 350 and then settle down to bat long. The pitch has started to take turn but Day 3 will be the one which will make the batsmen think twice. Join us for all the action from Day 2 at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Until then, ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Eventually, the Lankans have managed to pick up 7 wickets in the day as England kept going for runs. The run rate is a pretty decent one, at almost 3.5 an over. Sri Lanka started promisingly, but then could not quite get much out of the surface consistently. Lakshan Sandakan was honest and picked up 4 wickets while Pushpakumara took a couple.

A topsy-turvy day. Just as England had predicted they would play - bold cricket. They started shakily, losing their openers cheaply but then the 100-run stand between Bairstow and Root shored them up. That set the base as meaningful partnerships kept the Lankans at bay. Jonny boy went on to get to his hundred while Root and Stokes gave him good company. Not to forget, Ben Stokes was plumb LBW on 0 - but it was not given and Sri Lanka had exhausted their reviews.

Well, the umpires are not quite happy with the light out there. They take a reading and then offer it to the batsmen. No prizes in guessing that they are off. It is beyond 5 pm local time, so that will also be STUMPS ON DAY 1!

England's session all the way except for a minor blip where they lost their captain. They have motored along to 197-3 without facing much trouble. Jonny Bairstow has been super solid and played his shots as well. Ben Stokes was looking a little tentative when he came in to bat but once he spent some time in the middle, he too has found it easy and started to open up. Sri Lankan bowlers have been blunt and haven't created as many chances as they would've liked to. But there were a couple of chances which were turned down by the umpire and the replays showed it could've gone either way. But the Lankans have no one but themselves to blame as they wasted the reviews early on. The rain had just started to come down as the players went off for Tea, lets hope its a passing shower and play resumes normally. Join us in a bit for the final session.

Gets to the pitch of the ball and plays this in front of him.
Jonny presents the full face of the bat and blocks another one.
Around off, Bairstow covers his stumps and stonewalls this.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
DROPPED SHORT, AGAIN! Tossed up outside off, Jonny gets an edge towards de Silva at first slip. Dhananjaya gets low but the ball just bounces it front of him.
Loopy ball around off, Bairstow taps it in front of him.
Malinda Pushpakumara to roll his arm over.
Freebie missed out. Short ball on middle, Stokes rocks back to pull it but gets a bottom edge which dies down.
On middle and leg, Stokes turns it to the on side.
Comes down the track and gets to the ball outside off.
Gives this air on off, tapped with soft hands to the off side. They cross.
In line of the stumps, hit back to the bowler.
Outside off, reverse swept towards short third man for a run.
Wrong 'un outside off, Stokes cuts it through point to retain the strike.
Gets low and sweeps it towards square leg to give his partner the strike.
Stokes plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
JUST SHORT! Good reaction by Dhananjaya but just short. On off, Stokes gets caught on the back foot again. Gets an edge which falls just short of the first slip fielder.
Gives this air on off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! Effective! Outside off, Stokes reverse sweeps this with some connection past the slip fielder for a boundary.
On off, played to the on side.
Quicker ball on off, Stokes taps it to the off side with soft hands and rotates strike.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Floated ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
Darts this on the pads of Ben who flicks it away through mid-wicket. Another two runs taken.
Off spinner on middle and off, turned away against the spin.
Dhananjaya de Silva on for a bowl now.
FOUR! A bit short on middle and leg, Stokes goes back and pulls this over mid-wicket for another boundary. Looks good now.
Flighted ball down the leg side, Stokes looks to sweep it but misses.
Loopy ball outside off, Bairstow swipes it to deep square leg for a run.
Outside off, cut very late to backward point for a brace.
On leg, milked through mid-wicket to change ends.
Leg spinner around off, Stokes plays it into the ground.
On off, kept out.
Comfortably gets behind the ball and blocks it out.
Drifts this into Bairstow who looks to block it but then his bottom hand just comes off.
FOUR! Short again. Poor ball. Jonny goes back and cuts it through cover-point to bring up the 150 for the tourists.
Full and on off, Stokes comes down and creams it to long off for one.
On the shorter side on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
How close was that? Wrong 'un from Sandakan outside off. Spins away. Bairstow coves his off pole and lets it go.
On off, Bairstow leans ahead and stonewalls it.
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and outside off again, driven through covers for one.
Stokes read the spin and leaves this ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Too short down leg, Stokes rocks back, needs no second invitation and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
On leg, turned away around he corner.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman through mid-wicket. They pick up a single and Stokes is finally off the mark.

Long appeal! But the umpire stays put. Stokes is caught again on the back foot. Short on off, Ben looks to play it with a straight bat but misses. Hits him on the pads. No reviews for Sri Lanka left. Now then, replays show us that the ball would have gone to hit the stumps. Stokes gets away with one.
A bit short down leg, worked away towards square leg for one more.
On off, driven to extra cover for a comfortable couple.
Tossed up on middle and leg, turned to the leg side.
Loopy ball on that similar line, Stokes stonewalls it.
Around off, Stokes bunts it down.
On middle and leg, played with  a straight bat.
Wrong 'un outside off, Stokes looks to cut it but misses. A shaky start so far from Stokes.
Loopy ball around off, Bairstow paddles it softly towards short fine leg for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Bairstow paddles it softly towards short fine leg for a single.
Drinks!
Covers his stumps and bunts this one down.
Short ball over the stumps, Stokes gives it back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, Stokes on the back foot punches it to mid-wicket.
Quicker arm ball outside off, Stokes looks to cut it but misses.
Flatter ball on leg, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Played through mid-wicket by JB.
Spin on this occasion but Stokes plays it with the spin off the back foot and towards cover.
Flatter delivery, Stokes defends it off the back foot towards point.

Huge appeal! But given not out again. This ball is flatter and quicker on middle. The ball grips and turns as Stokes tries to jam it away on the leg side but misses to get hit on pads. The Lankans appeal for a long time but the umpire is unperturbed. Replays show that the ball was missing off stump. Good decision.
Full and outside off, Stokes defends it to cover.
Short and way outside leg, Bairstow stays back and pulls it away to deep square leg for a single.
Ben Stokes is the new man in.

OUT! Wicket against the run of play and at a totally unexpected time. The ball was flighted and going the other way, Root goes for a slog above mid-wicket but top edges this one high in the air. Gunathilaka has all the time in the world to come underneath it and pouches it comfortably. Root will be fuming, misses a fifty but mainly will be sad because of the way he has been dismissed. Nevertheless, a good partnership comes to an end.
Fuller and flighted a lot more outside off, Bairstow just dead bats it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on middle, JB plays it short mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Bairstow has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This ball is full and outside off, Root comes ahead and drives it to long off for a run. It also brings up the 100-run stand between these two. Massive partnership and batting has looked easy.
This one is outside off and turns in, Root prods forward and defends it.
Starts with a ball on leg, it is clipped straight to the fielder.
This one is slightly flatter and on middle. The captain plays it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball on middle, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full ball outside off, Root brings out the reverse sweep and picks up a couple.
Flighted outside off, Root comes ahead to defend but the ball hits the inside edge and the ball rolls onto the leg side.
This one is short outside off, Root goes back in his crease and opens his bat face to the gap wide of slip for four. Well-placed by the skipper.
Full and pushed back to the bowler by Root.
Flatter ball on off, defended by Bairstow on the back foot to the bowler.

LOUD APPEAL but turned down by the umpire. The ball was full and on middle. Bairstow goes for the hoick and misses the ball to get hit in front of the stumps. Umpire decides its Not out. Maybe the ball was sliding down and missing off stump.
Flatter delivery on middle, YJB is ahead in defense.
Flatter and on middle, Root pushes it to mid-wicket for another run.
In the air but safely in the gap. This one is full and on middle, Bairstow flicks it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Root comes down the wicket and takes this one on the full and hits it to long on for a single.
Fuller and looped on off stump, Bairstow defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Shorter this time, Bairstow stays back in his crease and cuts it away to the point boundary. Deep backward point can't get around in time as the outfield is too quick.
Flighted on off, Bairstow comes ahead and smothers the spin.
Similar ball and JB is well forward to defend it.
Fuller and on middle, Bairstow defends it on the bottom of his bat.
Outside off and flatter. Bairstow goes for the cut but misses it completely.
Lakshan Sandakan is into the attack now.
Full and on the pads, Root comes down the wicket and flicks it straight to square leg.

Loud appeal but the umpire is unmoved. This one is around the wicket and lands on middle and turns in slightly and hits Root on the front pad as he misses his flick. Looked in line but Sri Lanka have no review left.
Flatter trajectory outside off, Root punches it to cover for a single.
Flatter trajectory outside off, Root punches it to cover for a single.
Flighted and outside off, Root comes down the wicket and drives to short mid-wicket who fumbles but there's no run conceded.
Flighted up outside off, Bairstow goes down and sweeps it away to deep fine leg for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Root drives it again but fails to find the gap between cover and mid off.
On a good length outside off, Root drives to mid off.
New bat comes in for Joe Root.
Slower delivery outside off, Root reads it early and drives it but straight to short cover.
In the air but safe! Full delivery on the pads, Joe flicks it uppishly but away from the short mid-wicket fielder. Lucky.
Good length ball outside off, Bairstow defends it onto the ground on the off side and picks up a quick single.
Full and on off stump, driven to mid off.

50 for Bairstow! His 20th fifty in Test cricket. It's come of just 76 balls. Seems like a solution to England's No.3 conundrum. He has looked really positive and comfortable out in the middle. Coming to this ball, it was full and on middle. He sweeps it away for a single.
Flatter delivery again on middle, played toward mid wicket.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, Bairstow goes for the flick and misses the ball to be hit on his thigh pad.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Bairstow rocks back and cuts it beautifully in front of square on the off side for a boundary.
Lots of turn on this occasion but the ball begins on middle and ends up way outside leg. JB looks to play it fine but doesn't get bat on it.
Flatter ball outside off, Root pushes it to long on off his back foot and picks up a single.
Another effort ball from Lakmal, almost a half-tracker. Bairstow sways outside the way.
Bouncer on middle, Bairstow ducks under this one.
Similar delivery, Jonny covers the line and defends on his front foot.
Slightly overpitched, Bairstow mistimes his drive to short cover.
Outside off and on a length, Bairstow lets it go.
Short of a length and outside off, Root drops it on the off side and sets off for a quick single. Bairstow responds early and is comfortably in as the cover fielder has a shy at the striker's end.
Root comes down the wicket and plays this to long on for a single.
Flatter and on off stump, Root remains in his crease and defends.
Flatter on middle, Bairstow is back and flicks it away on the leg side for a run.
Flighted on middle, Bairstow gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Faster ball outside off, Root comes down the wicket and finds the gap on the leg side towards deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Looped on middle, Root pushes it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball just outside off and slightly coming in after landing. Bairstow covers the movement and defends it solidly.
Fuller and outside off, Root finally finds the gap to the left of cover and picks up a single to sweeper cover.
Wide outside off, Root reaches out and drives it. Dhananjaya de Silva at cover dives and makes a good stop and prevents the single again.
Good length ball, Root looks to push it in the gap on the off side but cover comes around and prevents the single.
Outside off and fuller in length, Root cover drives but straight to the fielder.
Full and on middle, Root drives it straight to mid on.
Flatter and aimed at the pads, Root works it behind square on the leg side, keeps strike with a run.
Darted in on off, Root stays back and defends this one.
Flighted on middle, Root comes down the wicket and defends it.
Fuller and on middle, Bairstow drives it to long on for a single.
Flatter and quicker on middle, JB plays it to square leg.
Flatter delivery on off, Bairstow pushes it to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, pushed solidly on the front foot to mid off.
Good length ball outside off, Bairstow is ahead in defense but gets an inside edge that rolls onto the leg side for a single.
Overpitched on the pads, Jonny plays it to mid on.
Fuller and drifting onto the pads, Root flicks it away to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Root goes for the drive and gets a thick inside edge onto the pads.
Starts off with a length delivery on top of off, Root stays tall and defends.
The players are making their way out after the Lunch break under the scorching sun. Joe Root will face the first ball which will be bowled by Suranga Lakmal.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Two contrasting hours of play in one session. The first hour belonged to Sri Lanka and the second hour belonged to the Brits without a doubt. The Islanders picked up both the openers in the first hour but since the drinks break, England have gone on the positive and even though there have been a couple of chances along the way, the two Yorkshire batsmen, Joe Root and Jonny Bairstow have looked pretty comfortable in the middle adding an unbeaten 66. It has mostly been all spin for the hosts, like we expected. Sri Lanka also lost both their reviews in the process. The runs were flowing towards the last few overs in that session and the hosts will have to come back after the break and hit their straps or else this Test could quickly be going out of their grasp. Join us in a while for the post Lunch session.
Root flicks this through mid-wicket for another run. That will be Lunch on Day 1.
Sweeps this through square leg for one more.
100 up for England. Pushes this towards mid off and gets a run to reach the milestone.
On off, swept to deep square leg to give Root the strike.
Down leg. Bairstow leaves it alone staying inside his crease.
Goes down to sweep but gets it off his glove to the leg slip fielder.
Similar ball and similar shot like the previous ball.
Loopy ball on off, hit back to the bowler.
On off, driven to covers.
Cheeky. Paddles it fine to fine leg for a comfortable brace. England doing it all.
Waits for the ball and then tucks it away.
FOUR! Root is no pushover. Shows Bairstow even he has it in him. Gets low and sweeps it in front of square through mid-wicket for a boundary.
YJB flicks it away with a wristy shot.
FOUR! Super shot. Gets on one knee and sweeps it with force through square leg. It won't be cut off and Jonny moves into the 40s.
Flatter ball on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Brings out the swipes it through square leg. Some tag-team there in the deep to keep it to two.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Takes it on the full and milks it through mid-wicket to bring up the 50-run stand. They will look to go into the break without further damage.
Dilruwan Perera to bowl.
Darts this on middle and leg, played with a straight bat.
Arm ball on leg, pushed to covers.
Goes deep in his crease and taps the ball towards cover-point.
On off, bunted down by Bairstow.
Gets low and brings out the broom towards deep square leg for a run.
A bit flat on off, turned to square leg.
A bit flat on off, turned to square leg.
Full toss on middle, JB comes down early and paddles it fine and comes back for two. Good running this!

NOT OUT! Sri Lanka lose both their reviews before Lunch. Over excitement, I tell you. Flatter ball outside off, Root looks to cut it late but is struck on his pads outside off. The bowler and the keeper are not quite sure but suddenly after some chat they take it upstairs. Replays roll in and show us that the impact was indeed outside off. They also get a leg bye as the ball went past the keeper.
Review time! Sri Lanka take a review for an LBW decision given against them. Impact looks outside off.
Short ball, Jonny rocks back and punches it towards covers for a run.
On off, Bairstow gets an inside edge onto his pads to the off side.
Leg spinner on middle, flicked but straight to mid-wicket.
Looped up just outside off, Root prods ahead and dead bats it.
Full and on off stump, Root defends it on the front foot.
Overpitched on middle, Root drives it to mid on.
Flighted on off, Root is well ahead in defense.
Flatter and darted in outside off, Root opens the face of his bat and runs it down to third man for a couple.
Full and on off stump, Root keeps it out on the front foot.
On off, kept out.
Leg spinners down leg again. Root misses his flick and Dickwella collects it.
Down the leg side. Root looks to help it on its way fine. It goes towards short fine leg where they cross. The umpire signals byes.
Kept low. Outside off, Bairstow rocks back and somehow manages to get bat to it. Hits it past point for one.
Leg spinner down leg, Jonny is ahead to whip it away but cannot connect well.
Loopy ball around off, Bairstow keeps it out.
Drifting back in, Root is watchful as he blocks it with a straight bat.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Around off, Jonny looks to drive it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

Beautifully bowled. Off spinner on middle and leg, Bairstow closes the bat face a bit early. Some extra bounce and turn and it almost kisses the outside edge of Jonny's bat. Dickwella collects it but does not appeal.
On off, Bairstow places it near the 22 yards.
Tossed up ball in line of the stumps, Bairstow taps it in front of him.
On middle and off, Root drops it just short of the short leg fielder.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, Bairstow punches the ball through mid on for one.
Darts this quicker in line. Jonny is solid in his defense.
Errs down leg, Bairstow still goes to sweep it. Gets it off his glove towards the on side.
Better. Makes Root goes goes his back foot by bowling it a bit quick and slightly short. Root pushes it to long on for one.
FOUR! Swept powerfully over mid-wicket for four runs. The ball is full and outside off, Root goes down on one knee and smashes it over mid-wicket and into the fence on one bounce.
SIX! First of the match. Sees the ball flighted, gets low and slogs it over mid-wicket for half a dozen. Bairstow now has a strike rate of above 100.
JB has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, driven past mid off for a single.
Another appeal from Dickwella. Darts this on leg. Root misses his flick and gets hit on the legs. The bowler straightaway says that it was going down leg.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, kept out to the off side.
Outside off, swept with disdain to deep square leg. Just one but 12 from the over.
Loopy ball on middle, this time Bairstow pays his respect.
Brings out the swipe again. Behind square for a brace as the fielder in the deep mops it up.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, deserved punishment. Jonny rocks back and cuts it through the vacant cover-point region for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Low full toss outside off, Bairstow swipes it from outside off and sweeps it with power. No fielder there and a boundary results.
Down leg, turned away to the on side for one. 50 up for the visitors.
Around off, Bairstow blocks it out.

NOT OUT! Waste of a review from Sri Lanka. Perhaps Lakmal was put under pressure from the close-in fielders and took it up. Loopy ball on off, Bairstow is ahead to block it out. He misses but there is a noise as Dickwella collects it. He appeals but the umpire stays put. Sri Lanka take the review. Replays show us that there is a huge gap between bat and pad. The third umpire then doesn't check for LBW as the spike is from the bat touching the ground and not the body. Sri Lanka lose a review.
Review time! Sri Lanka think they have got Bairstow caught behind. Let's see.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
On off, kept out.
Gets behind the ball and blocks it out.
Covers his stumps and bunts this down.
A long appeal. Tossed up ball on off. Bairstow is forward to defend but misses his block. Sri Lanka appeal but do not opt for the review. Impact outside the line there.
Joe works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

CHANCE! Stumping chance goes abegging here. Lovely loopy ball outside off. It spins back in. Root is forward to whip it away but gets beaten by the turn. The ball just spins past leg stump and Dickwella cannot collect the ball. The ball rolls towards fine leg where the batsmen take two byes.
Loopy ball on off, Jonny shuffles and milks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, cut to deep backward point. They jog to complete the run.
A bit on the shorter side on middle, Root punches it towards mid on.
Tossed up ball around off, Bairstow is solid in his defense.
Smart batting this. Field change so he just nudged the ball around the corner to get off strike.
FOUR! Enough is enough says Joe. Flighted ball on off, Root gets low, reaches for it and swipes it front of square, through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another ball given air on middle and leg. Root is happy to block it out.
Arm ball on the pads of Root who stonewalls it.
Loopy ball around off, hit back towards the bowler.

It's time for the first Drinks break of the match. What an engrossing first hour of play! Sri Lanka will definitely be happy with the two wickets but will have to keep up the pressure and not let England off the noose. The ball is gripping and turning as expected. Batting should be tough but not impossible. Root and Bairstow will have a short term target of not losing their wickets at least till Lunch.
Flatter ball on off, the batsman is on the back foot and punches this one back to the bowler.
Fuller and outside off, driven to mid off.
Shorter and outside off, enough time for Root to go back and punch it away to deep point for a single.
Full toss on middle, swept away for a single by JB.

Good ball! This one is flighted outside off and turns in a long way. Bairstow comes ahead to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. No risk though as the ball just drops down away from any fielder.
Starts off around the wicket and flatter on the pads. Bairstow works it away on the back foot but short leg is in the way.
Lakshan Sandakan to roll his arm.
Full and on off, kept out by Root who is half-ahead.
Joe Root is the new man in.

OUT! What an inspired fielding change by Lakmal. Leg slip had just been placed there after the previous ball and Jennings guides it straight into his arms. The ball was on middle and Jennings looks to turn it away fine with the spin. To his dismay, there was Roshen Silva waiting for just that who takes a good low catch. Walked right into the trap there is Keaton. Jennings waits for a bit, no idea why. The umpires then ask him to keep marching towards the dressing room. Good start for Pushpakumara, wicket in his first over.
FOUR! Good paddle sweep by the left-handed Jennings. The ball was flatter and on off but the batsman is down early and paddles it away fine for four.
Fuller and on off again, Bairstow drives to long off for a run.
Beautiful loop and on off, Bairstow is well ahead and defends solidly.
Flighted outside off and a bit of turn, Bairstow lets it go.
Malinda Pushpakumara is the first bowling change this morning.
Slightly fuller this time, Jennings defends on the front foot.
Another reverse sweep to a full one on middle, but straight to the fielder.
Shorter and outside off, Bairstow rocks back and punches it away in the gap to the left of cover. The ball is just stopped inside the fance, the batsmen come back for three though.
Flatter ball outside off, Jennings pushes it in the gap towards cover-point. Good fielding there as the fielder dives to stop this one but it doesn't prevent the single.
Faster and fuller this time on middle, Jennings connects the reverse sweep much better this time but straight to backward point.
Looped up outside off, Jennings goes for the reverse sweep but the ball comes off the inside part of the bat and bounces before going to gully.
Good ball to end the over. On length and off stump, but Johnny has the line covered as he defends.
Slightly fuller and on middle, pushed away to mid on.
Three slips and a gully to the right-hander. Starts off with a good length ball just on top of off stump, Bairstow comes ahead as he defends.
On the hips of Keaton who tucks it away to the on side and sets off for a quick. Puts the fielder on pressure and completes the run eventually.
Back of a length this time, once again outside off. Jennings is not enticed to play at it.
On a good length outside off, Jennings points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.

FOUR! Off the mark straightaway and in some style. The ball was looped up outside off and Bairstow is positive as he drives on the front foot through the covers. The ball just speeds away through the grass and all the way to the boundary. What good timing! It looked like a mere push but has brought him four.
Jonny Bairstow is in at no. 3.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Burns misses a straight one and the ball hits the off stump. Burns has looked tentative this morning with his footwork. He plays on the back foot to one that he should've probably been ahead to. The ball is flatter and skids on after landing to hit the off pole. Rory rocks back to cut it but is beaten. Sri Lanka celebrate as they draw first blood.
Looped up on middle, Burns is ahead and drives to mid on.
Flatter and darted in on middle, Jennings is on the back foot to punch it to deep point for a single.
Outside off, pushed to cover.
Full and flighted so much so that its almost yorker length, Jennings digs it out toward short mid-wicket.
Slightly short of a length to end the over. Burns stands tall and defends it into the ground.
Outside off and short of a good length, Burns defends away from his body toward gully.
This one is short of length and jags in after landing. Burns is cramped for space and gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad and the ball just goes above his stumps and behind to the keeper.
Fuller and on middle and off, Burns is on his front foot and drives it to mid on.
Good length ball on off, that ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads, rolling towards cover.
Shorter on length and outside off, Burns punches it off the back foot to point but no run taken.
Shorter ball outside off, Burns rocks back and cuts it to deep point. Picks up a single to keep strike.
Shorter in length and on middle, Burns goes back and jabs it toward mid on.
Full and on middle, Burns covers the line and defends it.

Jennings is unsure of his footwork here, comes forward and tries to flick a full one on the leg side but gets a leading edge that flies wide of slip and to the right of backward point. The batsmen run one.
BEATEN! This one had Jennings all squared up. Lands on off and straightens a tad bit. Jennings plays the wrong line and is lucky that the ball did not take out his off stump. So close!
Flatter ball on off, Jennings prods ahead to defend this one.
FOUR! Great timing and quick outfield here. This one was on a length outside off, Burns comes ahead and drives away from his body but in the gap through the covers. The ball rushes away to the fence.
Shortens the length a tad bit, Burns remains on his back foot and defends it into the ground.
Length ball outside off, Burns takes a step ahead and defends it straight back to the bowler.
This is a much better over from Lakmal. This ball is on a good length and Burns comes forward to push it onto the off side but the ball takes his inside edge and onto his pads.
Short of a good length and on middle, Burns shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Bouncer on middle, really carried through beautifully above the batsman's head as Dickwella had to jump to catch this one. Sri Lankans go up for an appeal but Burns was nowhere close to the ball with his attempted pull.
Fuller and on middle, Keaton comes ahead and keeps it out.
Shorter outside off, Burns cuts it away in the gap toward cover-point for a single.
Flatter delivery on off, defended off the front foot by Burns presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and slower outside off, spins away and Burns looks to cut away but the ball is too far away from him to get a good connection. Just able to get it away to point in the end.
Flatter delivery at the pads, Jennings stays back in the crease and works it behind square leg for a run.
Flighted ball on middle, kept out on the front foot.
Good ball on length and coming in with the angle, Jennings pushes toward mid-wicket and keeps the strike with a single.
Wayward bowling here, Lakmal drifts onto the pads again. Burns plays it to Pushpakumara at fine leg. Just a single though.
No Ball. Lakmal oversteps. The ball is on length and outside off, defended watchfully by Burns.
Around the wicket and angling in toward the off pole, Burns defends it toward short cover.
Length ball at the pads, Burns plays this off the back foot toward short mid-wicket.
Full and at the pads again, Burns flicks it away but can't find the gap this time.
FOUR! The first boundary of the game. An overpitched delivery at the pads, Burns flicks it away easily in front of square leg for four runs. Good chase by the fielder but the ball wins the race.
Flatter and darted in outside off, Burns cuts it to point but Pushpakumara misfields and the batsmen run three as the ball is stopped just inside the fence.
Flighted but drifting onto the pads, Burns plays it to square leg.
Looped up on middle and off and takes the edge this time, but flies wide of slip towards short third man. The batsmen run one.
First runs of the morning, Jennings paddles this on middle and leg towards fine leg and picks up a couple.
Looped up on middle, Jennings comes ahead to defend.
Begins with a flatter and quicker one on off, Jennings cuts it to point.
Dilruwan Perera to bowl from the other end.
Starts off with a maiden over as Burns lets this go outside off again.
Slightly short of a length and outside off, Burns shoulders his arm to it at the last moment.
Good length outside off, Burns chooses to leave this one.
On length and on top of off stump, Burns defends with a straight bat.
Length ball on middle, Burns stays inside his crease and keeps it out.
Starts off with a slightly fuller delivery outside off. Defended coming half-ahead by Burns.

The players and the umpires are ready to take the field. Time for live action. Rory Burns and Keaton Jennings will open the batting for England while Suranga Lakmal will open the bowling for the Lankans. Three slips and a gully in place for Lakmal.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold says its a very hot day and there could be some rain in the evening.  He also feels that the boundary sizes are bigger. Adds that the pitch looks dry and his companion, Brad Hogg feels that the wicket already looks like a Day 3 wicket and there are patches in the middle that could crack wide open. Russel then goes on to add that it's a lot more drier than the previous pitches and should spin more. Nevertheless, he also says that the batsmen can score runs if they adapt and apply themselves and put in a mindset to not only survive but also find a way to score runs.

TEAM NEWS - Sri Lanka bring in Danushka Gunathilaka and Lakshan Sandakan in place of Kaushal Silva and Akila Dananjaya. England have got in Johnny Bairstow and Stuart Broad in place of Sam Curran and James Anderson.
TOSS - England have won the toss and opted to bat first.

Welcome to the third and final Test between Sri Lanka and England. This tour has been a mauling of sorts for the hosts. Sri Lanka have been forced to make a minimum of two changes due to the injury to Dinesh Chandimal and Akila Dananjaya being reported for a suspect action. England have already announced their playing XI as they give a game to Jonny Bairstow and Stuart Broad. Hopefully the rain stays away and we have an uninterrupted game. The hosts will look to go out, express themselves and have fun in the middle as the series is already gone, whereas, England will look to clean sweep a Test series away from home. Can the Islanders put up a fight and salvage some pride in the final game?
